eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 9:50 PM on AUG 13, 2024 Effective until 7:50 AM AUG 14, 2024. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Maricopa County. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. The Mesa Police Department is looking for 17-year-old Isaiah Armstrong. Isaiah is a black male, 5 feet 11 inches tall, 150 pounds, with brown hair and brown eyes. He was last seen wearing a black shirt and khaki pants and orange shoes carrying an orange draw string backpack, Isaiah also has braces. He was last seen on foot August 12, 2024, at 4:25 P.M. when he left his residence in the area of University and Lindsey in Mesa, Arizona. Isaiah is familiar with riding the light rail. Isaiah suffers from a condition which can make him seem to become lost or easily confused. If you have seen or have any contact with Isaiah, please call the Mesa Police Department 480-644-2211 or 9 1 1. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
